entries.text: 并# align + 瓦 tile/earthenware → align earthenware on the ground (to dry) → *pair of earthenware well buckets* → *pot*; *bottle*; *glossy container*.
似小瓿。大口而卑。用食。从瓦扁聲。
As per 秋# (shrunken) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → brick *wall of a well* (← prevent well water from evaporating, a form of shrinking). Also, a place *paved with flat stones* as well as *floor tile*.
井壁也。从瓦秋聲。
As per 垔# as described in 煙 (adhere) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → *ceramics*; *porcelain* (← earthenware to which glaze adheres). Also, *distinguish between* (superior and inferior products).
匋也。从瓦垔聲。

瓦 here an abbreviation for the phonetic construction 瓦蘭姆 (gram) + 厘. In the 尺貫法 （シャッカンホウ） measuring system Japan inherited from China 厘 represented 1/100 of a unit, so the combination of elements here creates the meaning *one centigram* (= 0.01 gram).
康瓠，破罌。从瓦臬聲。
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → small, curved *pot/jug/container*.
小盆也。从瓦區聲。
An abbreviated form# of 夢 (obscure) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → *rafters* obscured in supporting roofing tiles → *roofing tile*; *tiled roof*.
屋棟也。从瓦，夢省聲。
As per 專# (round and/or rotating object) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → round(ed) tile (compare 塼) → *tile* (of any kind); *brick*.
As per 曾# (steaming pot) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → earthenware *rice steaming pot*. 甑 was devised to replace 曾 after 曾 acquired its extended meanings.
甗也。从瓦曾聲。
As per 辟# (spread) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → *tiles* (spread over a roof/floor); *floor tiles*.
瓴甓也。从瓦辟聲。《詩》曰：“中唐有甓。”
As per 雍# (contain) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → *jug/cistern* (← particular kind of container; compare 缸 and 瓮).
As per 鬳# as described in 獻 (cooking vessel) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → *earthenware vessel* (for steaming grain).
甑也。一曰穿也。从瓦鬳聲。讀若言。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 口 mouth + a line#, indicating (sweet/rich) food contained and thus concealed within the mouth → *tasty*; *mild*; *delicious* → *sweet* (← sweet food contained in the mouth) → *indulgent*; *lenient*; *spoil* (a person) (← be overly sweet) → *insufficiently serious*; *overly optimistic*; *loose*; *take advantage* → *be content* (with); *be resigned* (to); *accept* (← indulge oneself and take the easy way out).
美也。从口含一。一，道也。凡甘之屬皆从甘。

As per 匹 (side by side) + 甘# (sweet/rich food contained in the mouth) → consume extreme amounts of sweet/rich food → *intensity*; *great degree* → *very*; *extreme*; *enormous*; *exceedingly*; *excessively*; *serious*; *outrageous*.
尤安樂也。从甘，从匹耦也。
美也。从甘从舌。舌，知甘者。
甘# sweet + 舌 tongue → *sweet* food on the tongue → *sweetness*.

The relevant seal inscription form is an abbreviated form# of 艸 grass/plant + 土 earth → fresh, slender grass shoots → *birth*; *life* → *new*; *fresh*; *sprout*; *raw*; *alive*; *by nature*; *youth*; *unripe*; *pure*; *bear fruit*; *spare a life*; *bring back to life*; *make use of*; *make a living*; *be/remain valid*; *arrange flowers/plants*; *grow*; *undiluted*.
進也。象艸木生出土上。凡生之屬皆从生。
眾生並立之兒。从二生。《詩》曰：“甡甡其鹿。”

產.explanation: Common traditional-script shape for “produce; property; products”; the 2013 mainland appendix prints 産 instead of 產 in its traditional column.
產.usageCaveat: A regional character-form distinction, not a separate sense of “produce”.
產.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix row directly checked for classification; lexical equivalence is not a context-free replacement.

産.explanation: Traditional-column form printed for 产 in the 2013 mainland standard; visually differs from the more familiar 產 used in some traditional-writing regions.
産.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix row directly checked for classification; lexical equivalence is not a context-free replacement.

entries.text: 生# birth; life + an abbreviated form of 彦 (handsome/well-formed) → well-formed offspring/product → *produce*; *production*; *childbirth*; *local product/material*. Also, *one's birthplace*.
生也。从生，彥省聲。
草木實甤甤也。从生，豨省聲。讀若綏。
生# birth; life + 男 man/male → male child (born to a sister), i.e. *nephew*. Also, *son-in-law* (adopted into a family). In Japanese, 甥 indicates the male child of a brother as well.
謂我舅者，吾謂之甥也。从男生聲。
生# birth; life + 更 change → *be resuscitated*; *be revived*; *be reborn*.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character depicts a stick being run through a rectangular board, piercing a hole → *use*; *action* → *have a need* → *go to the toilet* (← have a need to relieve oneself).
可施行也。从卜从中。衞宏說。凡用之屬皆从用。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows a seedling curving upward in spreading from a field or seedbed → *broad/wide*; *great*. Also, *beginning* (← beginning of a plant's life cycle) → *for the first time*. (*Suffix for male names*) is a borrowed meaning.
男子美稱也。从用、父，父亦聲。

As per 用# (run through) + a variant of 人 person (→ human agency) → run an object through. *Narrow path/road* (walled on both sides) is via reinterpretation (← path/road allowing people to run through), while an ancient Chinese *unit of weight* ( 斗 x 10) is a borrowed meaning (← cylindrically shaped measuring container).
艸木華甬甬然也。从𢎘用聲。
A variant form of 寧 *peaceful*. *Choose* is a borrowed meaning.
所願也。从用，寕省聲。
A depiction of level, cultivated land divided into neat, contiguous sections → *field*; *paddy*.
陳也。樹穀曰田。象四囗。十，阡陌之制也。凡田之屬皆从田。

A depiction of a long-necked (alcohol) container from the mouth of which liquid contents pass/run through, being poured in a slender arc → *cause*; *origin*; *by means of* (← pour from) → *reason*; *circumstances* → *significance*; *purport*. Compare 酉 and 卣.

Originally, a depiction of objects being pressed down, suggesting "press down on objects in containing them" → *armor*; *helmet*; *shell*. From the bronzeware inscription style onward, however, the character becomes a depiction of a hard, seed-bearing *husk*. *First in a series* and *first calendar sign* are borrowed meanings.
東方之孟，陽气萌動，从木戴孚甲之象。一曰人頭宐爲甲，甲象人頭。凡甲之屬皆从甲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows a bolt of lightning stretching from sky to earth. A seal inscription form, however, is a pair of hands + a straight line representing a rope → pair of hands tugging on/stretching a rope. *Say* is a borrowed meaning, as are *monkey* (as the *ninth sign of the Chinese zodiac*) and *3 P.M. to 5 P.M.*.
神也。七月，陰气成，體自申束。从臼，自持也。吏臣（段注“臣”作“以” ）餔時聽事，申旦政也。凡申之屬皆从申。
鬼頭也。象形。凡甶之屬皆从甶。
田# field + 力 power/energy → strong, limber *man* working a field.
丈夫也。从田从力。言男用力於田也。凡男之屬皆从男。

田# field + 勹 wrap → *land about the imperial capital* and under direct rule of the emperor → *outskirts*; *suburbs*; *cultivated land*; *crops*. Logically, the classifier for 甸 should be 勹, but it is traditionally given as 田.
天子五百里地。从田，包省。
亟詞也。从丂从由。或曰甹，俠也。三輔謂輕財者爲甹。
As per 丁# (straight) + 田 field → straight paths running between fields → *town* (← まち originally referred to streets in a settled area) → *sector*.
田踐處曰町。从田丁聲。

The element at top originally had a horizontal line drawn through it, as visible in the derivative character 湽. This element combined 才 (cut off) + the horizontal line for emphasis/clarification. The original form of 甾 added 田 field → cut weeds in a field and pile them, preparing for plowing. *Calamity* is a borrowed meaning, via 菑, with *evil* by extension.
東楚名缶曰甾。象形。凡甾之屬皆从甾。
田民也。从田亡聲。
Depiction of an object bound by a cord + a variant of 廾 pair of hands → pass an object from hand to hand, to the end of the line → *give*; *bestow*.
相付與之。約在閣上也。从丌甶聲。
田# field + 攵 action indicator → *cultivate* a field → *hunt*; *hunting* (← alternate method of obtaining food). Logically, the classifier for 畋 should be 攵, but it is traditionally given as 田.
平田也。从攴、田。《周書》曰：“畋尒田。”
介# (reduce) + 田 field → boundaries reducing a large field into smaller sections → *boundary*; *border* → *world*/circle (of the arts etc.).
境也。从田介聲。
犬# dog/beast + 田 field. However, the element now represented as 犬 was originally 巛, a variant form of 川 river → *watercourse running between fields*.
The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows a club held by 鬼# (large, lumpy being) → fearsome, lumpy being that clubs its prey → *fear*; *apprehension*; *dread*; *awe* → *reverence*.
惡也。从甶，虎省。鬼頭而虎爪，可畏也。
火 fire + 田 field → burn off weeds and stalks in fields to render them fertile → *field*; *farm*. Also, *one's field of specialty* (← field in the figurative sense). Compare 畠.
As per 半# (split) + 田 field → *ridge*/path splitting fields → (water's) *edge*.
田界也。从田半聲。
比田也。从二田。凡畕之屬皆从畕。
滿也。从高省，象高厚之形。凡畗之屬皆从畗。讀若伏。

As per 卯# (bend) + 田 field → field laborer coming to a stop in stooping with exhaustion (compare 勞) → *stop*; (temporarily) *stay/settle*; *hold down*; *detain*; *fix in place* → *keep* (in mind). 留 employs the same variant of 卯 as in 貿.
A variant form of 番 (basket used in sowing) → *straw basket*.
As per the right-hand element# as described in 珍 (fullness) + 田 field → *path running between fields* (fully connecting all of them).
井田閒陌也。从田㐱聲。
玄 an abbreviated form# of 幼 young + 田 (here a shape indicator suggesting partitioned pens) → young *livestock* contained in partitioned pens → *domestication*.
田畜也。《淮南子》曰：“玄田爲畜。”

田 field + an element# combining 攵 (strike) and an obsolete character of uncertain identity. The original intent seems to have been "strike (with a hoe or plow) in creating ridges or furrows" → *ridge*; *furrow* → *unit of measurement*. Also, *rib* (in ribbed cloth). 畝 replaces 攵 with 久.

The top element# combines 田 here an abbreviated form of 甾 (cut weeds in a field) + 儿 person (→ human agency) → prepare a field for plowing. 畟 adds 夂 leg/foot pointed downward (→ drag) → create piles of soil in dragging a *plow*.
治稼畟畟進也。从田、人，从夊。《詩》曰：“畟畟良耜。”
白 white (here suggesting "parched") + 田 field → *dry field* (as opposed to a paddy) → *farm*. Compare 畑.
A depiction of a net spread over prey attempting to split away in escape, indicating the *end* of a chase → *finish*; *complete*.
田罔也。从𠦒，象畢形。微也。或曰：甶聲。
As per 寺# (stand straight) + 田 field → *worship site* (standing in a field) → *festival grounds*.
天地五帝所基址，祭地。从田寺聲。右扶風有五畤。好畤、鄜畤，皆黃帝時祭。或曰秦文公立也。

各 here an abbreviated form# of 洛 (connect) + 田 field → paths connecting fields → *manage* → *abbreviate* (← make shortcuts) → *consider*; *outline*; *broadly*; *tactics* (← tactically effective shortcuts). *Plunder* is a borrowed meaning.
經略土地也。从田各聲。
As per 圭# (neat) + 田 field → a neat *ridge* that partitions fields.
田五十畝曰畦。从田圭聲。

釆# scattered seeds + a representation of a basket (now written 田) → reach into a basket and scoop up seeds to spread/sow them → *number*; *order* (← count the number of times the hand is inserted into a basket) → *keep watch* (← keep watch over in turn). 釆 replaces an obsolete character that likewise indicated seeds or grain.
獸足謂之番。从釆；田，象其掌。

Originally, 晝# (demarcate in writing) + 聿 implement held upright to carve/draw characters → *demarcate*/*mark off* in writing → *draw*; *paint* → *drawing*; *picture*; *painting* → *stroke* (n.). Also, *plan* and *consider* (← written plan).
界也。象田四界。聿，所以畫之。凡畫之屬皆从畫。
三歲治田也。《易》曰：“不葘，畬田。”从田余聲。
六尺爲步，步百爲畮。从田𣫭聲。
As per 夋# as described in 俊 (stand erect) + 田 field → *agricultural administrator* (← one who stands erect in overseeing, in contrast to farm workers who bend in labor; compare 留 and 労).
農夫也。从田夋聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows 廾 pair of hands raised straight above to the sides of a person's head (in affixing a crown). *Different* and *unusual* are extended meanings (← person different from all others, and thus unusual).
分也。从廾从畀。畀，予也。凡異之屬皆从異。
止也。从田丣聲。

As per 尚# (disperse) + 田 field → disburse (= disperse) an amount of money fitting the value of a field → *fit." "Fit (together)" has produced a slew of extended meanings, including *be on the mark*, *face*, *hit*, *aim*, *purpose*, *expectation*, *guess*, *object*, *put/place against*, *pawn* and *deserve*.
田相值也。从田尚聲。
叕# connect + 田 field → connecting *(ridge) path*.
兩陌閒道也，廣六尺。从田叕聲。
As per 奇# (lean) + 田 field → irregularly-shaped portion of land that leans/juts out from a field → *remainder*; *odd (sum/number)* → *strange*; *crippled*; (physically) *defective*.
殘田也。从田奇聲。
田三十畝也。从田宛聲。
田 field (doubled) bounded and partitioned by three horizontal lines → tightly demarcated fields, about which *border* markers stretch → *boundary*.
界也。从畕；三，其界畫也。
不生也。从田昜聲。
An abbreviated form# of 幾 minute + 田 field → small plot of land → *territory near the capital* (no residual connection with minuteness) → *capital*. Compare 圻.
天子千里地。以遠近言之，則言畿也。从田，幾省聲。
𣂀也，古田器也。从甾疌聲。
燒穜也。《漢律》曰：“疁田茠艸。”从田翏聲。
禽獸所踐處也。《詩》曰：“町疃鹿場。”从田童聲。
轢田也。从田粦聲。
彊# strong + 土 earth → fortified, earthen *border/boundary*.

As per 壽# (ridge) + 田 field → *ridge*; *farmland* → *same type/kind* (← continuous farmland) → *category* (group of the same kind of people/objects). As with 壔, 疇 was devised to replace 壽 after 壽 came to indicate "longevity."
耕治之田也。从田，象耕屈之形。

畾 is a variant of an element adding another 夕 to the bottom left of 多 (tall, neat pile of meat). 疊 adds 宜 (originally, also piled meat). 疊 therefore expresses the tautological idea of pile up + pile → *pile/fold* an object to a number of layers → *fold up*; *tatami* → *put an end to* (← fold and put away after using).

The relevant seal inscription form is 足 leg/foot written in reverse, suggesting a pair of legs pointing in opposite directions → *leg*. *Counter* (for animals or bolts of cloth) and *unit of measurement* (for lengths of cloth) are borrowed meanings via 匹, which also supplies the ヒツ reading.
足也。上象腓腸，下从止。《弟子職》曰：“問疋何止。”古文以爲《詩·大疋》字。亦以爲足字。或曰胥字。一曰疋，記也。凡疋之屬皆从疋。
疾也。从止从又。又，手也。屮聲。

𤴔# a variant of 疋 (point in opposite directions) + 束 bundle → pair of piled objects, set at a distance from each other → *distant* → *shun*; *neglect* (← keep at a distance). Also, *ignorant* and *unfamiliar* (with) (← distant from one's knowledge or experience) as well as *disagreeable* (← unpleasant thing, kept at a distance). *Pass through* and *sparseness* are borrowed meanings via 疏.
𤴔# a variant of 疋 (point in opposite directions) + 㐬 as described in 流 (flow) → *pass through* in flowing between opposite points. Other meanings pertaining to this character are borrowings via 疎.
通也。从𡿮从疋，疋亦聲。
礙不行也。从叀，引而止之也。叀者，如叀馬之鼻。从此與牽同意。

As per 矣# (come to a stop) + an obsolete element of unclear composition and signification. *Question* may be regarded as originating in the idea of "stop and interrogate a person," leading to the associated meanings *suspicion* and *doubt*.
惑也。从子、止、匕，矢聲。
The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines 人# person + 片 long, wooden sleeping pallet → ill person on a sickbed → *illness*.
倚也。人有疾病，象倚箸之形。凡疒之屬皆从疒。
As per 丁# (straight) + 疒 illness → *boil* or *carbuncle* rising straight on the skin. Compare 瘍.
頭瘍也。从疒匕聲。
As per 久# (long and curved) + 疒 illness → *lengthy/chronic illness* (one causing the body to curve/hunch) → *guilt*; *remorse* (← protracted mental affliction).
小腹病。从疒，肘省聲。
As per 山# (dense/lumpy objects) + 疒 illness → *illness* causing the rupture of skin in the form of lumps/protrusions.
腹痛也。从疒山聲。
火 here an abbreviated form# of 炎 (consuming blaze) + 疒 illness → *fever*; *intermittent fever*.
熱病也。从疒从火。
As per 尤# (skin eruption) + 疒 illness (for emphasis/clarification) → *wart*.
As per 巴# (spread) + 疒 illness → *scar* spread over the skin. Compare 瘢.
As per 介# (reduce) + 疒 illness → *scabies* (illness that causes scratching, by which the top layer of skin is reduced) → *psoriasis*.
搔也。从疒介聲。
𤺉也。从疒，決省聲。
病也。从疒氏聲。
殳 an abbreviated form# of 役 (series) + 疒 illness → *epidemic* (← illness that strikes serially).
民皆疾也。从疒，役省聲。
包# envelop + 疒 illness → ailment in which a protrusion is enveloped by skin → (water) *blister*. Compare 皰.
As per 皮# (align) + 疒 illness → align the legs and *bend* over on account of *fatigue* (compare 留) → *get/be tired*.
勞也。从疒皮聲。
As per 甘# (contain) + 疒 illness → *gastroenteric disorder afflicting children*, the origin of which is contained deep within the body → *childhood illness(es)*.
病也。从疒可聲。《五行傳》曰：“時卽有口痾。”
As per 此# (irregular) + 疒 illness → irregularly shaped *bruise* on the skin → *wound*; *illness* → *flaw*; *fault*; *defect*; *demerit*; *weakness*.
病也。从疒此聲。
As per 旦# (long and flat) + 疒 illness → *jaundice* (condition associated with feces that is long and flat at the edges).
黃病也。从疒旦聲。
As per the right-hand element# as described in 珍 (fullness) + 疒 illness → illness causing a *rash* that fully covers the body. "Measles" properly pertains to the compound 痲疹.
毆傷也。从疒只聲。
冬# winter + 疒 illness → stinging *pain* experienced in the cold of winter → *sting*; *smart*; *ache*; *twinge*.
As per 且# (pile) + 疒 illness → a *swelling*; *boil*; *carbuncle*. Compare 疵 and 瘡.
癰也。从疒且聲。
矢 here an abbreviated form# of 至 stopping point + 疒 illness → *illness* hastening death → *swiftness* (← hasten).
病也。从疒矢聲。
As per 句# (bend) + 疒 illness → *illness resulting in curvature of the spine* → *hunchback*. Compare 佝 and 姁.
曲𦟝也。从疒句聲。
有熱瘧。从疒占聲。《春秋傳》曰：“齊侯疥，遂痁。”
As per 加# (place atop) + 疒 illness → *scab* that forms atop a wound.
疥也。从疒加聲。
As per 玄# (link) + 疒 illness → linked series of spasms (compare 癇) → *cramps*.
As per 丙# (spread) + 疒 illness → spreading *illness/disease* → *suffering*; *worry*; *distress*; *bad habit*.
疾加也。从疒丙聲。
As per 正# (straight) + 疒 illness → *symptom* as a direct (= straight) indicator of an *illness*.
As per 全# (fully) + 疒 illness → *healing of/recovery from an illness* (← full recovery).
動病也。从疒，蟲省聲。
As per 夷# (downward) + 疒 illness → *wound* caused by a downward slash.
傷也。从疒夷聲。
亥 here an abbreviated form# of 骸 bones/skeleton + 疒 illness → body rendered bony/skeletal by *malaria*. Compare 瘧.
二日一發瘧。从疒亥聲。
疻痏也。从疒有聲。
馬病也。从疒多聲。《詩》曰：“痑痑駱馬。”
An abbreviated, variant form of 癢 *itchy*, combining 羊# + 疒 illness.
瘍也。从疒羊聲。
As per 寺# (stand straight) + 疒 illness → *piles*; *hemorrhoids* (← affliction that forces one to stand).
後病也。从疒寺聲。
As per 艮# (adhere) + 疒 illness → *scar* adhering to the skin → *mark*; *trace*.
胝瘢也。从疒艮聲。
豆# bean + 疒 illness → *smallpox* (disease that causes bean-shaped pustules to rise on the skin).
As per 巠# as described in 徑 (extensive) + 疒 illness → extensive, long-lasting twitching or spasms → *twitch*; *spasm* → *cramp*; *convulsive fit*.
彊急也。从疒巠聲。

As per 甬# (run through) + 疒 illness → *pain* running all through the body → *hurt*; *ache*; *sore*; *injure*. Also, *damage*, *trying* (experience), *pitiful*, *miserable*; *tragic* and *horrible* (← painful experience), as well as *thoroughly* and *extremely* (← thoroughgoing/extreme pain).
病也。从疒甬聲。
As per 否# (spread/bulge) + 疒 illness → painful spreading or bulge within the body → *pressure/pain on account of intestinal blockage*; *tightness in the chest*.
痛也。从疒否聲。
酸痟，頭痛。从疒肖聲。《周禮》曰：“春時有痟首疾。”
As per 甫# (spread) + 疒 illness → *illness* spreading over the body → *fatigue* caused by illness.
病也。从疒甫聲。《詩》曰：“我僕痡矣。”
利# (sharp) + 疒 illness → sharp abdominal pain and *diarrhea* accompanying *dysentery*.
志 here an abbreviated form# of 誌 (permanent) record + 疒 illness → *birthmark* (likened to a permanent record on the skin) → *mole*; *spot*.
As per 坐# (circular) + 疒 illness → circular *lump*, *boil* or *pimple*.
小腫也。从疒坐聲。一曰族絫。
馬脛瘍也。从疒兌聲。一曰將傷。
The variant form 瘦 is as per 叟# (narrow/thin) + 疒 illness → illness that causes one to *grow thin* → (land that becomes) *sterile/barren*.
脈痬也。从疒易聲。
疢# fever + 火 fire → *phlegm* (which in ancient China was associated with heat).
風病也。从疒非聲。
As per 𣏟# as described in 麻 (hemp) + 疒 illness → medical condition characterized by *numbness* (← stupefactive properties of hemp) → *paralysis*. *Measles* properly pertains to the compound 痲疹.
林 here an abbreviated form# of 淋 drip + 疒 illness → disease that causes fluids to drip from the body → *gonorrhea*.
疝病。从疒林聲。
气不定也。从疒季聲。
溼病也。从疒𢌿聲。

As per 卑# (low) + 疒 illness → disease that stunts growth. However, 痺 became confused with 痹, which is as per 畀 (pass an object from hand to hand until it reaches the ultimate recipient → stretch) + 疒 illness → *numbness* that stretches over the body → *paralysis*.
As per 固# (hardened/hard object) + 疒 illness → *chronic illness* (causing the body to harden).
As per 阿# (bend) + 疒 illness → disease/illness that causes the body to bend → *chronic illness*.
As per 委# (hang low) + 疒 illness → illness causing one to hang low → *lose strength*; *weaken*; *go numb*; *atrophy*. Compare 萎.
痹也。从疒委聲。
